_role: A: driver-filed, held fee to release (wait 10 >= 8); rider chat says driver cancelled

dispute_ticket.description: Passenger did not come to Jurong East MRT Exit B. I waited 10 minutes, tried calling, then cancelled as a no-show. The S$4.00 fee was put on hold after the rider objected, but I did what the policy says. Please release the held fee to me.

pickup_location.name: Jurong East MRT (Exit B taxi stand)

chat_logs.content: Hi, I'm at Jurong East MRT Exit B taxi stand, grey Honda Grace.
Waiting at the pickup point, please come.
Outgoing call to rider - not answered (rang 25s, no response).
Trip cancelled by driver. Reason: rider_no_show. Cancellation fee of $4.00 applied.
You cancelled the trip, not me. I was still walking from the other exit.

app_events.details: Rider R-6602 booked trip RYDE-CS-009 from Jurong East MRT (Exit B taxi stand) to Tuas Link MRT. Pickup 22:10.
Driver D-9150 (Mohamed Hakim Bin Yusof, Honda Grace Hybrid (SMF 6619 R)) assigned.
Driver tapped 'I'm Here'. Arrival recorded for the pickup point.
Push notification + in-app alert sent to rider: 'Your driver has arrived.'
Wait timer started at driver arrival. 5 min free wait period ends at 22:14.
Free 5-min wait period expired. Rider had not boarded.
Driver initiated in-app call to rider. Call rang 25s, no answer.
Cancel pressed by driver D-9150. Reason selected: rider_no_show.
Cancellation fee S$4.00 held pending review (rider objected that the driver cancelled). Not yet credited to driver.
Driver D-9150 released from trip. Trip status: cancelled (rider_no_show).

free_wait_time_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before any waiting or cancellation fee may apply to the rider.

no_show_threshold_min.text: Minutes the driver must wait at the pickup point, counted from arrival, before the rider counts as a no-show.

cancellation_fee_after_wait.text: The fee in SGD charged to the rider when a booking is cancelled after the driver has waited past the free waiting time. It covers rider cancellations and rider no-shows, including the no-show cancellation the driver presses after waiting past the threshold; it does not cover a cancellation the driver makes for the driver's own reasons.

fee_goes_to.text: Says who receives a cancellation or no-show fee once it is charged. It governs where the money goes, not whether the fee is due.

expected_outcome.reason: Driver arrival is recorded at 22:09:00 with GPS at the pickup from 22:09 to 22:19. The driver pressed cancel at 22:19:00, a wait of 10 minutes, past this trip's 8-minute no-show threshold. The driver messaged and called with no reply. The rider's 22:24 chat that the driver cancelled is true but does not change the outcome: the policy fee covers the no-show cancellation the driver presses after the threshold. The held S$4.00 is released to the driver.
